content.short: Mass is a mobile DeFi app offering trading, on-ramp and off-ramp, limit orders, and access to on-chain and off-chain data.
content.description: Mass reduces chaos in the DeFi world by unifying your activities across the ecosystem into a single mobile experience. It replaces scattered platforms, browser wallets, and PWAs with a streamlined, efficient, safe, and user-friendly interface. With Mass, you access a broad set of features in one place, designed for both seasoned users and newcomers alike, making complex DeFi workflows easier to manage on the go without compromising security or clarity.

resources.title: Most Tokens Will Never Reach Their ATH Again. Why?
resources.tldr: Dilution is the answer, and it is a much less comfortable one than market sentiment. A short piece that reframes how to read a token's price history.

resources.title: Making Gas Tokens a Thing of the Past
resources.tldr: Opens on the familiar dead end of holding tokens you cannot move because you have no ETH for gas, then covers how paying fees in any asset removes it.

resources.title: Trading With Onchain Data Instead of Guesswork
resources.tldr: Nobody has a crystal ball, but most people trade with far less onchain information than is freely available. A survey of what data is worth watching.
